label: D-235383

defects.summary: Deviation 57 says S5.6.7's cancelled arm accepts either a non-answered row status or an OperationCanceledException, but the test accepts only the throw (`asking.Should().ThrowAsync<OperationCanceledException>`), so the recorded deviation is not true.

Deviation 53 says 'the three refusals theory rows gained kimi × web', but the diff adds only one InlineData row (to ConfinementPlannerTests' refusal theory), and deviation 50/the skeleton header ('no test was run, the fill regions throw', MustCarryNoFlags a fill region) describes a state the final change no longer has.
Decision 2 says each Kimi row's note carries the version (2.1.1); the notes do not (the version is only in measuredWith.version), and this is not recorded as a deviation.
TheVectorsCoverKimi re-asserts what the existing TheVectorsActuallyLoaded_AndCoverEveryPairOfTheTable already covers for S5.6.2 (deviation 52), so it is a redundant test.
The private Scopes class and StandIn() are copied verbatim into both new test classes from AKimiConsultationScenarioTests instead of being shared.

S5.5.1 does not check the canary on its own; it relies on state 'answered' meaning that no tree-changed breach occurred, and the cwd check is a weak Contain(own\tree) instead of a check that the path is under the scratch.

summary: The production change matches the spec exactly and stays small: the kimi planner arm adds no flags (Snapshot for disk, Scratch for none), the three rows have the decided standings and cells, there are three vectors, Runtimes and the generated table gain kimi, and KimiConsultant refuses a plan with any Leading/Flags/AddDirs; all 12 scenarios exist and pass, and the junction-first tests got teeth through the KimiHome unlink recorder. The defects are in the record and are small: two deviations (53, 57) are not true of the code, the skeleton notes are stale, the version is missing from the notes, and there is a little test duplication.
